items.title: New branch and switch to it
items.description: Create a branch from the current commit and check it out.

items.title: List all branches
items.description: Local and remote-tracking branches, current one marked with *.

items.title: Delete a merged branch
items.description: Safe delete (refuses if unmerged); use -D to force.

items.title: Pretty log graph
items.description: One-line history with branch graph across all branches.

items.title: Unstage a file
items.description: Remove a file from the staging area, keeping edits.

items.title: Discard changes in a file
items.description: Throw away uncommitted edits to a file (cannot be undone).

items.title: Undo last commit, keep changes staged
items.description: Move HEAD back one commit; files stay staged.

items.title: Undo last commit, keep changes unstaged
items.description: Mixed reset: commit is undone, edits remain in the working tree.

items.title: Discard last commit and its changes
items.description: Hard reset: destroys the commit and its edits.

items.title: Revert a commit safely
items.description: Create a new commit that undoes an earlier one (safe for shared branches).

items.title: Amend the last commit message
items.description: Rewrite the message of the most recent commit (local only).

items.title: Add a forgotten file to the last commit
items.description: Stage the file and fold it into the previous commit.

items.title: Recover lost commits with reflog
items.description: Show where HEAD has been; find a commit to reset or branch from.

items.title: Stash including untracked files
items.description: Save work in progress with a label.

items.title: Stash: list, apply, pop, drop
items.body:
git stash list
git stash apply stash@{0}   # keep the stash
git stash pop               # apply and remove the newest
git stash drop stash@{0}
items.description: Common stash operations.

items.title: Interactive rebase last N commits
items.description: Squash, reword, reorder or drop recent commits.

items.title: Rebase onto the latest main
items.body:
git fetch origin
git rebase origin/main
items.description: Replay your branch on top of origin/main.

items.title: Cherry-pick a commit
items.description: Apply a single commit from another branch onto the current one.

items.title: Show and change remotes
items.description: List remotes, add one, or change its URL.

items.title: Push: new branch and safe force push
items.body:
git push -u origin HEAD
git push --force-with-lease
items.description: First push sets the upstream; --force-with-lease only overwrites if nobody else pushed.

items.title: Delete a remote branch
items.description: Remove a branch from origin, then prune stale tracking branches.

items.title: Create and push an annotated tag
items.body:
git tag -a v{{version}} -m "Release {{version}}"
git push origin v{{version}}
items.description: Tag a release and publish the tag.

items.title: Stop tracking a committed file
items.description: Remove a file from Git but keep it on disk (then add it to .gitignore).

items.title: .gitignore patterns
items.body:
# comment
node_modules/     # a directory anywhere
*.log             # all .log files
/build            # only at repo root
!keep.log         # re-include an exception
**/temp/          # temp dirs at any depth
.env
items.description: Common ignore-file patterns and their meaning.

items.title: Find the commit that broke something
items.body:
git bisect start
git bisect bad
git bisect good {{good_commit}}
# test, then mark each step: git bisect good | git bisect bad
git bisect reset
items.description: Binary search through history with bisect.
